audit_scope: Independent v4 requirement, routing, handoff, provenance and display review; not a claim that all 51-package functionality is identical.

test_runs.command: py -3.13 -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_v4_integration.py -v
py -3.13 -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_independent_workflow.py -v

test_data_notice: Synthetic engineering fixtures in temporary directories only. No actual GOAT/DFT calculation, experimental dataset or scientific approval was created by this audit.
requirements_checked: H defaults to 1 Hz Lorentzian FWHM; C defaults to 2 Hz. Display-only CLI linewidth overrides preserve the QM protocol hash and reject nonpositive/nonfinite values.

Main released registry contains exactly 1,020 independent GOAT starts for 66 product structural models plus TMS: 1,012 product starts and 8 TMS starts. Starts are not final optimized conformer counts.
All active starts use explicit 2 DMSO-d6 + 1 ordinary H2O. ALPB(DMSO) sampling and CPCM(DMSO) DFT coexist with explicit molecules; no continuum-only prerequisite.

All six actual Figure 4 structures traverse temporary synthetic completed-output handoffs to PBE/pcJ-3 J jobs only. J2 selection for these drugs is rejected. Figure 2/3 retain both benchmark candidates.
Negative modes require source-bound human review without an automatic frequency-magnitude acceptance threshold; approved exceptions remain labelled approximations, not certified minima.
Human-review hashes, limitations and scientific status survive Opt/Freq, ensemble and property handoffs. Changed reviews and historical-wave parent/G tampering are rejected.
Multiplet comparison uses the actual experimental field, requires source-bound experimental artifacts and returns recommendations rather than automatic approval.
No active revDSD stage, no automatic cluster submission, no automatic retry, and no completed-target-calculation claim.

scientific_inputs_still_required: Actual completed GOAT sampling, accepted DFT optimization/frequency, shielding and J results for targets and matched TMS; none produced by this audit.
Actual solvent, temperature, water content, sample protonation/tautomer and stereochemical identities. 2 DMSO + 1 water is a model choice, not a measured solvent shell or water concentration.
F4_D07 neutral DMSO model remains provisional; salt/protonation and alternative solvent need sample-owner confirmation.
F2_E11 and F2_E22 separate stereochemical branches must not be pooled without justified experimental composition.
Independent experimental J benchmarks and assigned experimental multiplet/lineshape data; no accuracy certification is supplied by program tests.
Sampling wave, solvent-motif and basin rediscovery review; the 8/12/16/24/32 start budgets do not establish convergence.

Internal exact proton spin blocks are limited to at most 10 H without F. Larger/F-containing strong-coupling cases need an appropriate reviewed external spin solver or explicit approximation review; an external transition handoff is available, not scientifically validated here.
limitations: Full 51-package functional equivalence is not certified.
Geometry, parser and pipeline tests do not validate experimental molecular identities, chemical shifts or yields.
Reviewed negative modes remain approximate thermochemistry; no claim that an imaginary-mode structure is a true minimum.
This independent audit does not perform the separate full 1,020-geometry static audit, all package tests or archive verification; those are delivery-level checks recorded separately.
